name: State-space model (no attention)
change: Attention is replaced entirely by a selective state-space recurrence; there is no KV cache, only a fixed-size state per layer.
problem_solved: Memory and per-token compute no longer grow with context length.
trade_off: No exact lookup of earlier tokens; recall must fit in the state.
kv_formula: 0 bytes per token; fixed state per layer

reference.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
